findings.text: The status says no command writes to the store, although the prototype writes a local store and loads all six tables in `clickhouse-local`. Fix: Limit the statement to the persistent ClickHouse service.

The specification says the prototype ran the rules below, but the reviewed revision’s folding test expects both `T.ctorIdx` and `_private.N.0.T.eq_1` to be reported where the revised rule 5 would fold them into `T`. Fix: Identify the rule version that ran and mark the broader prefix lookup as a proposed correction.

Rule 4 instructs the extractor to emit a generated `initFn` as a declaration, which contradicts ADR 0032 D6 and can count one written command as two users. Fix: Describe the duplicate row as a prototype defect and require the helper to fold into its written parent or be reported when its parent cannot be identified.

Rule 5 assumes that following a parent yields a declaration, although the prototype also reports helpers whose parent chain ends at a reported constant. Fix: State that the extractor reports the original helper when its parent chain ends without a declaration.

The command-range rule assumes reparsing recovers the command seen during elaboration, although the prototype uses the module’s final environment and the status record identifies later syntax declarations that can change the parse. Fix: Record this limitation and require the extractor to report an unresolved range when it cannot establish the original command boundaries.
